definitions.full: H7632. shabib [ שָׁבִיב ] noun masculine probably flame (Biblical Aramaic שְׁבִינ ); — construct אִשּׁוֺ שְׁבִיב יִגַּהּ וְלֹא Job 18:5 (|| אוֺר ); so Ecclus 8:10; Ecclus 45:19.
